standard.coverage: All covered employers. The highest general minimum wage of any US state-level jurisdiction.
standard.note: D.C. Code 32-1003 annual CPI-W adjustment every July 1. A January-only refresh cycle carries a stale DC rate for half the year.

tipped.note: Initiative 82's tip-credit phase-out was RE-CUT by the Council in 2025: instead of eliminating the tip credit outright, the tipped wage is now a PERCENTAGE of the full minimum wage -- frozen at $10.00 through 2026-06-30, then 56% of the minimum wage from 2026-07-01 (56% of $18.40 = $10.304, published as $10.30), 60% from 2028-07-01, and +5 points every two years thereafter to a 75% cap on 2034-07-01.

scheduledChanges.note: Next step of the amended Initiative 82 schedule; the standard rate continues to index each July 1.
